 color = Color3.fromRGB(
                    math.floor(255 * cycle),
                    math.floor(255 * cycle),
                    math.floor(255 * cycle)
                )
                
                applyTextColorToAll(color)
            end))

        elseif mode == "ErisRainbow" then
            textEffectConnection = track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
                elapsed = elapsed + dt
                local cycle = (elapsed * 0.167) % 1
                
                local color
                if cycle < 0.333 then
                    local t = cycle / 0.333
                    color = Color3.fromRGB(
                        math.floor(255 - 255 * t),
                        0,
                        0
                    )
                elseif cycle < 0.667 then
                    local t = (cycle - 0.333) / 0.334
                    color = Color3.fromRGB(
                        math.floor(255 * t),
                        math.floor(255 * t),
                        math.floor(255 * t)
                    )
                else
                    local t = (cycle - 0.667) / 0.333
                    color = Color3.fromRGB(
                        255,
                        math.floor(255 - 255 * t),
                        math.floor(255 - 255 * t)
                    )
                end
                
                applyTextColorToAll(color)
            end))

        elseif mode == "ShylfieRainbow" then
            textEffectConnection = track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
                elapsed = elapsed + dt
                local cycle = (elapsed * 0.4) % 1

                local color
                if cycle < 0.5 then
                    local t = cycle * 2
                    color = Color3.fromRGB(
                        255,
                        math.floor(215 + (255 - 215) * t),
                        math.floor(0 + 255 * t)
                    )
                else
                    local t = (cycle - 0.5) * 2
                    color = Color3.fromRGB(
                        255,
                        math.floor(255 - (255 - 215) * t),
                        math.floor(255 - 255 * t)
                    )
                end

                applyTextColorToAll(color)
            end))

        elseif mode == "SukunaRainbow" then
            textEffectConnection = track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
                elapsed = elapsed + dt
                local cycle = (elapsed * 0.4) % 1

                local color
                if cycle < 0.5 then
                    local t = cycle * 2
                    color = Color3.fromRGB(
                        math.floor(200 * t),
                        math.floor(20 * t),
                        math.floor(25 * t)
                    )
                else
                    local t = (cycle - 0.5) * 2
                    color = Color3.fromRGB(
                        math.floor(200 - 200 * t),
                        math.floor(20 - 20 * t),
                        math.floor(25 - 25 * t)
                    )
                end

                applyTextColorToAll(color)
            end))

        elseif mode == "NeonPulse" then
            textEffectConnection = track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
                elapsed = elapsed + dt
                local pulse = (math.sin(elapsed * 3.5) + 1) / 2
                local color = Color3.fromRGB(
                    math.floor(0 + 100 * (1 - pulse)),
                    math.floor(200 + 55 * pulse),
                    math.floor(180 + 75 * pulse)
                )
                applyTextColorToAll(color)
            end))

        elseif mode == "GoldenShine" then
            textEffectConnection = track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
                elapsed = elapsed + dt
                local shine = (math.sin(elapsed * 1.2) + 1) / 2
                local color = Color3.fromRGB(
                    255,
                    math.floor(180 + 75 * shine),
                    math.floor(0 + 120 * shine)
                )
                applyTextColorToAll(color)
            end))

        elseif mode == "FireEffect" then
            textEffectConnection = track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
                elapsed = elapsed + dt
                local cycle = (elapsed * 2.2) % 1
                local color
                if cycle < 0.33 then
                    local t = cycle / 0.33
                    color = Color3.fromRGB(255, math.floor(60 * t), 0)
                elseif cycle < 0.66 then
                    local t = (cycle - 0.33) / 0.33
                    color = Color3.fromRGB(255, math.floor(60 + 120 * t), 0)
                else
                    local t = (cycle - 0.66) / 0.34
                    color = Color3.fromRGB(255, math.floor(180 + 75 * t), math.floor(100 * t))
                end
                applyTextColorToAll(color)
            end))

        elseif mode == "IceBlue" then
            textEffectConnection = track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
                elapsed = elapsed + dt
                local t = (math.sin(elapsed * 0.9) + 1) / 2
                local color = Color3.fromRGB(
                    math.floor(140 + 115 * t),
                    math.floor(200 + 55 * t),
                    255
                )
                applyTextColorToAll(color)
            end))

        elseif mode == "PurpleGlow" then
            textEffectConnection = track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
                elapsed = elapsed + dt
                local t = (math.sin(elapsed * 0.7) + 1) / 2
                local color = Color3.fromRGB(
                    math.floor(140 + 80 * t),
                    math.floor(40 + 40 * t),
                    math.floor(220 + 35 * t)
                )
                applyTextColorToAll(color)
            end))

        elseif mode == "MatrixGreen" then
            textEffectConnection = track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
                elapsed = elapsed + dt
                local flicker = (math.sin(elapsed * 6.0) + 1) / 2
                local bright = (math.sin(elapsed * 1.4) + 1) / 2
                local color = Color3.fromRGB(
                    math.floor(0 + 30 * flicker),
                    math.floor(180 + 75 * bright),
                    math.floor(30 + 50 * flicker)
                )
                applyTextColorToAll(color)
            end))

        elseif mode == "RainbowFast" then
            textEffectConnection = track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
                elapsed = elapsed + dt
                local hue = (elapsed * 0.45) % 1
                applyTextColorToAll(Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1))
            end))

        elseif mode == "Sunset" then
            textEffectConnection = track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
                elapsed = elapsed + dt
                local cycle = (elapsed * 0.28) % 1
                local color
                if cycle < 0.5 then
                    local t = cycle * 2
                    color = Color3.fromRGB(255, math.floor(80 + 80 * t), math.floor(50 * (1 - t)))
                else
                    local t = (cycle - 0.5) * 2
                    color = Color3.fromRGB(255, math.floor(160 - 80 * t), math.floor(50 * t))
                end
                applyTextColorToAll(color)
            end))

        else
            warn("Efecto de texto no reconocido: " .. tostring(mode))
        end
    end

    function Window:Hide()
        if not uiHidden then
            hideUI()
        end
    end

    function Window:Show()
        if uiHidden then
            hideUI()
        end
    end

    function Window:Destroy()
        shutdownUI()
    end

    function Window:CreateStatsSection(tab)
        local TabPage = tab.Page

        local function setBilingual(obj, es, en)
            obj:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", es)
            obj:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", en)
        end

        local function buildIdMap()
            local seen, list = {}, {}
            for _, entry in ipairs(Window._GlobalOptionRegistry) do
                if entry.Kind == "Slider"
                    and type(entry.GetValue) == "function"
                    and type(entry.SetValue) == "function" then
                    local base = tostring(entry.Id)
                    seen[base] = (seen[base] or 0) + 1
                    local id = base
                    if seen[base] > 1 then id = base .. "#" .. seen[base] end
                    table.insert(list, {
                        id = id,
                        tab = base:match("^(.-)::") or base,
                        entry = entry,
                    })
                end
            end
            return list
        end

        local STATS_CHECK = 103456899356871
        local STATS_COLORS = {
            ok = Color3.fromRGB(70, 210, 120),
            warn = Color3.fromRGB(240, 190, 60),
            err = Color3.fromRGB(240, 85, 85),
        }

        local function openPanel(titleES, titleEN, maxW, maxH, iconImage, subES, subEN)
            local Backdrop = mk("TextButton", {
                Parent = Window.ScreenGui,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Active = true,
                AutoButtonColor = false,
                Text = "",
                ZIndex = 500,
            })
            local Panel = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = Window.ScreenGui,
                Size = UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0.9, 0),
                Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.04,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ClipsDescendants = false,
                ZIndex = 501,
            })
            Panel:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
            corner(Panel, 18)
            mk("UISizeConstraint", {
                Parent = Panel,
                MinSize = Vector2.new(260, 220),
                MaxSize = Vector2.new(maxW, maxH),
            })
            local PanelScale = mk("UIScale", {Parent = Panel, Scale = 0.9})

            -- Borde con luz que gira (un solo tween nativo)
            local ring = mk("UIStroke", {Parent = Panel, Thickness = 1.6, Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Transparency = 0.05})
            local ringGrad = mk("UIGradient", {Parent = ring, Rotation = 0})
            do
                local base = Theme.Stroke
                local h, s, v = Color3.toHSV(Theme.Accent)
                local light = Color3.fromHSV(h, math.max(0, s - 0.3), math.min(1, v + 0.25))
                ringGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, base), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.35, base),
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.47, Theme.Accent), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, light),
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.53, Theme.Accent), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.65, base),
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, base),
                })
            end
            local ringSpin = TweenService:Create(ringGrad, TweenInfo.new(5, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, false), {Rotation = 360})
            ringSpin:Play()

            -- Brillo superior suave
            local glow = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = Panel,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 90),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.86,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ZIndex = 501,
            })
            glow:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
            corner(glow, 18)
            mk("UIGradient", {
                Parent = glow,
                Rotation = 90,
                Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)}),
            })

            local IconTile = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = Panel,
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 44),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.78,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ZIndex = 502,
            })
            IconTile:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
            corner(IconTile, 13)
            local tileRing = stroke(IconTile, Theme.Accent, 1, 0.5)
            tileRing:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
            if iconImage then
                RowKit.Icon(IconTile, iconImage, 24, 503, "Accent")
            end

            local Title = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = Panel,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -130, 0, 22),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 72, 0, 17),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = GetText(titleES, titleEN),
                TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
                TextSize = 17,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                ZIndex = 502,
            })
            Title:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
            setBilingual(Title, titleES, titleEN)

            if subES then
                local Sub = mk("TextLabel", {
                    Parent = Panel,
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, -130, 0, 16),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0, 72, 0, 40),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Text = GetText(subES, subEN),
                    TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
                    Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
                    TextSize = 11,
                    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                    TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                    ZIndex = 502,
                })
                Sub:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "TextDim")
                setBilingual(Sub, subES, subEN)
            end

            local CloseBtn = mk("TextButton", {
                Parent = Panel,
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32),
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
                Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 16),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.2,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Text = "×",
                TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                TextSize = 20,
                AutoButtonColor = false,
                ZIndex = 503,
            })
            CloseBtn:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
            CloseBtn:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
            corner(CloseBtn, 999)
            stroke(CloseBtn, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.5)

            local Divider = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = Panel,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 1),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 72),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Stroke,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.55,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ZIndex = 502,
            })
            Divider:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Stroke")

            TweenService:Create(Backdrop, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.45}):Play()
            TweenService:Create(PanelScale, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()

            local closed = false
            local function close()
                if closed then return end
                closed = true
                playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.4)
                TweenService:Create(Backdrop, TweenInfo.new(0.16), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
                local shrink = TweenService:Create(PanelScale, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Scale = 0.9})
                shrink.Completed:Connect(function()
                    pcall(function() ringSpin:Cancel() end)
                    Panel:Destroy()
                    Backdrop:Destroy()
                end)
                shrink:Play()
            end
            CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(close)
            Backdrop.MouseButton1Click:Connect(close)

            return Panel, close
        end

        -- Pie: mensaje de estado en una pastilla de color + boton principal
        local function addFooter(Panel, statusY, btnES, btnEN, btnW)
            btnW = btnW or 150
            local StatusPill = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = Panel,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -(btnW + 44), 0, 30),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -50),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ZIndex = 502,
            })
            corner(StatusPill, 999)
            local dot = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = StatusPill,
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, -4),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Visible = false,
                ZIndex = 503,
            })
            corner(dot, 999)
            local Status = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = StatusPill,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, 0),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = "",
                TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                TextSize = 11,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                ZIndex = 503,
            })

            local Btn = mk("TextButton", {
                Parent = Panel,
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(btnW, 38),
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
                Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -54),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
                Text = GetText(btnES, btnEN),
                TextColor3 = Theme.AccentText,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
                TextSize = 13,
                AutoButtonColor = false,
                ZIndex = 503,
            })
            Btn:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
            Btn:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "AccentText")
            setBilingual(Btn, btnES, btnEN)
            corner(Btn, 12)
            mk("UIGradient", {Parent = Btn, Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(215, 215, 215))})
            local BtnScale = mk("UIScale", {Parent = Btn, Scale = 1})
            Btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
                TweenService:Create(BtnScale, TweenInfo.new(0.08), {Scale = 0.95}):Play()
            end)
            Btn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
                TweenService:Create(BtnScale, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
            end)
            Btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                TweenService:Create(BtnScale, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {Scale = 1}):Play()
            end)

            -- kind: "ok" | "warn" | "err" | nil (neutro)
            local function setStatus(kind, es, en)
                local color = STATS_COLORS[kind] or Theme.TextDim
                Status.Text = GetText(es, en)
                Status.TextColor3 = color
                dot.Visible = true
                dot.BackgroundColor3 = color
                StatusPill.BackgroundColor3 = color
                StatusPill.BackgroundTransparency = kind and 0.85 or 1
            end
            return Status, Btn, setStatus
        end

        local function openPlaceStats()
            local Panel = openPanel("Place Stats", "Place Stats", 400, 360, "rbxassetid://98421914514000",
                "Aplicá los ajustes de otro usuario", "Apply another user's settings")

            local Steps = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = Panel,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 24),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 84),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                ZIndex = 502,
            })
            mk("UIListLayout", {Parent = Steps, FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center})
            local stepChips = {}
            for i, st in ipairs({{"Copiá el código", "Copy the code"}, {"Pegalo acá", "Paste it here"}, {"Aplicá", "Apply"}}) do
                local chip = mk("Frame", {
                    Parent = Steps, Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                    BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary, BackgroundTransparency = 0.35, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = i, ZIndex = 503,
                })
                chip:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
                corner(chip, 999)
                mk("UIPadding", {Parent = chip, PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 3), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10)})
                mk("UIListLayout", {Parent = chip, FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder})
                local num = mk("TextLabel", {
                    Parent = chip, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent, BackgroundTransparency = 0.7,
                    Text = tostring(i), TextColor3 = Theme.Text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextSize = 10, LayoutOrder = 0, ZIndex = 504,
                })
                num:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
                num:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
                num:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
                corner(num, 999)
                local lbl = mk("TextLabel", {
                    Parent = chip, Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Text = GetText(st[1], st[2]), TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 10, LayoutOrder = 1, ZIndex = 504,
                })
                lbl:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "TextDim")
                setBilingual(lbl, st[1], st[2])
                stepChips[i] = {chip = chip, num = num}
            end
            local function markStep(n)
                for i, c in ipairs(stepChips) do
                    local done = i <= n
                    c.num.BackgroundTransparency = done and 0 or 0.7
                    c.num.TextColor3 = done and Theme.AccentText or Theme.Text
                    c.num:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", done and "AccentText" or "Text")
                end
            end
            markStep(1)

            local Field = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = Panel,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 1, -214),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 118),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.3,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ZIndex = 502,
            })
            Field:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
            corner(Field, 12)
            local fieldStroke = stroke(Field, Theme.Stroke, 1.2, 0.5)

            local Input = mk("TextBox", {
                Parent = Field,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -44, 1, -12),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 8),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Text = "",
                PlaceholderText = GetText("Código copiado del Export Stats...", "Code copied from Export Stats..."),
                TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                PlaceholderColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
                Font = Enum.Font.Code,
                TextSize = 12,
                TextWrapped = true,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
                ClearTextOnFocus = false,
                MultiLine = true,
                ZIndex = 503,
            })
            Input:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
            Input:SetAttribute("PlaceholderSpanish", "Código copiado del Export Stats...")
            Input:SetAttribute("PlaceholderEnglish", "Code copied from Export Stats...")
            Input:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)

            local ClearBtn = mk("TextButton", {
                Parent = Field,
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24),
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
                Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 8),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.3,
                Text = "×",
                TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                TextSize = 15,
                AutoButtonColor = false,
                Visible = false,
                ZIndex = 504,
            })
            ClearBtn:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
            ClearBtn:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "TextDim")
            corner(ClearBtn, 999)
            ClearBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.4)
                Input.Text = ""
            end)

            Input.Focused:Connect(function()
                fieldStroke.Color = Theme.Accent
                fieldStroke.Transparency = 0.05
                fieldStroke.Thickness = 1.6
            end)
            Input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
                fieldStroke.Color = Theme.Stroke
                fieldStroke.Transparency = 0.5
                fieldStroke.Thickness = 1.2
            end)

            -- Validacion en vivo
            local Check = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = Panel,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 16),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -88),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = "",
                TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                TextSize = 10,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                ZIndex = 502,
            })
            Check:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)

            local _, StartBtn, setStatus = addFooter(Panel, -48, "Aplicar ajustes", "Apply settings", 160)

            local function parseCode(code)
                if not code or code:match("^%s*$") then return nil, "empty" end
                local ok, data = pcall(function()
                    return HttpService:JSONDecode(code)
                end)
                if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return nil, "invalid" end
                if data.version ~= 1 then return nil, "version" end
                if type(data.sliders) ~= "table" then return nil, "nosliders" end
                return data
            end

            local function refreshCheck()
                local text = Input.Text
                ClearBtn.Visible = text ~= ""
                local data, why = parseCode(text)
                if not data then
                    markStep(text == "" and 1 or 2)
                    if why == "empty" then
                        Check.Text = GetText("● Esperando un código", "● Waiting for a code")
                        Check.TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim
                    else
                        Check.Text = GetText("● El código no es válido", "● The code is not valid")
                        Check.TextColor3 = STATS_COLORS.err
                    end
                    return
                end
                local byId = {}
                for _, item in ipairs(buildIdMap()) do byId[item.id] = true end
                local total, match = 0, 0
                for id in pairs(data.sliders) do
                    total = total + 1
                    if byId[id] then match = match + 1 end
                end
                markStep(3)
                Check.Text = GetText(
                    "● Código válido · " .. total .. " ajustes · " .. match .. " coinciden con tus sliders",
                    "● Valid code · " .. total .. " settings · " .. match .. " match your sliders")
                Check.TextColor3 = match > 0 and STATS_COLORS.ok or STATS_COLORS.warn
            end
            Input:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(refreshCheck)
            refreshCheck()

            StartBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                local data, why = parseCode(Input.Text)
                if not data then
                    if why == "empty" then
                        setStatus("err", "El campo está vacío", "The field is empty")
                    elseif why == "version" then
                        setStatus("err", "Versión de código no compatible", "Unsupported code version")
                    elseif why == "nosliders" then
                        setStatus("err", "El código no trae ajustes", "The code has no settings")
                    else
                        setStatus("err", "Código inválido", "Invalid code")
                    end
                    return
                end

                local byId = {}
                for _, item in ipairs(buildIdMap()) do
                    byId[item.id] = item.entry
                end

                local applied, skipped = 0, 0
                for id, raw in pairs(data.sliders) do
                    local entry = byId[id]
                    local v = tonumber(raw)
                    if entry and v and v == v and v ~= math.huge and v ~= -math.huge then
                        local lo, hi = tonumber(entry.Min), tonumber(entry.Max)
                        if lo and hi then v = math.clamp(v, lo, hi) end
                        if pcall(entry.SetValue, v) then
                            applied = applied + 1
                        else
                            skipped = skipped + 1
                        end
                    else
                        skipped = skipped + 1
                    end
                end

                playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.6)
                if applied == 0 then
                    setStatus("warn", "No se aplicó ningún ajuste", "No settings were applied")
                elseif skipped > 0 then
                    setStatus("ok",
                        applied .. " aplicado(s) · " .. skipped .. " omitido(s)",
                        applied .. " applied · " .. skipped .. " skipped")
                else
                    setStatus("ok",
                        applied .. " ajuste(s) aplicados",
                        applied .. " setting(s) applied")
                end
            end)
        end

        local function openExportStats()

            for _, item in ipairs(items) do
                if not tabSet[item.tab] then
                    tabSet[item.tab] = true
                    table.insert(tabNames, item.tab)
                end
                tabCount[item.tab] = (tabCount[item.tab] or 0) + 1
            end

            for _, name in ipairs(tabNames) do
                checked[name] = true
            end

                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Text = GetText("No hay sliders para exportar todavía.", "There are no sliders to export yet."),
                    TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
                    Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
                    TextSize = 12,
                    TextWrapped = true,
                    ZIndex = 503,

                Empty:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "TextDim")
                setBilingual(Empty, "No hay sliders para exportar todavía.", "There are no sliders to export yet.")

            local rowsUI = {}
            local function refreshSummary()
                local total, tabsOn = 0, 0
                for _, name in ipairs(tabNames) do
                    if checked[name] then
                        total = total + (tabCount[name] or 0)
                        tabsOn = tabsOn + 1
                    end
                end
                BigNum.Text = tostring(total)
                SumText.Text = GetText("ajustes para exportar", "settings to export")
                SumSub.Text = GetText(tabsOn .. " de " .. #tabNames .. " pestañas", tabsOn .. " of " .. #tabNames .. " tabs")
                ExportBtn.BackgroundTransparency = total > 0 and 0 or 0.5
            end

            local function paintRow(r, animate)
                local on = checked[r.name]
                local info = TweenInfo.new(animate and 0.18 or 0, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
                TweenService:Create(r.box, info, {BackgroundColor3 = on and Theme.Accent or Theme.Background, BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 0.2}):Play()
                r.box:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", on and "Accent" or "Background")
                r.mark.Visible = on
                r.stroke.Color = on and Theme.Accent or Theme.Stroke
                r.stroke.Transparency = on and 0.25 or 0.6
                r.stroke:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", on and "Accent" or "Stroke")
                r.row.BackgroundTransparency = on and 0.2 or 0.5
            end

            for i, tabName in ipairs(tabNames) do

                local RL = mk("TextLabel", {

                    Position = UDim2.new(0, 82, 0, 0),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,

                    TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                    TextSize = 13,
                    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                    TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                    ZIndex = 504,
                })
                RL:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")

                local n = tabCount[tabName] or 0
                local CountChip = mk("TextLabel", {
                    Parent = Row,
                    Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 22),
                    AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
                    Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.5, 0),
                    BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
                    BackgroundTransparency = 0.82,
                    Text = GetText(n .. (n == 1 and " slider" or " sliders"), n .. (n == 1 and " slider" or " sliders")),
                    TextColor3 = Theme.Accent,

                    ZIndex = 504,

                CountChip:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")

                local RowBtn = mk("TextButton", {
                    Parent = Row,
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Text = "",
                    AutoButtonColor = false,
                    ZIndex = 506,
                })
                local r = {name = tabName, row = Row, box = Box, mark = Mark, stroke = rowStroke}
                rowsUI[#rowsUI + 1] = r
                RowBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

                    paintRow(r, true)

            local function setAll(value)
                playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.4)
                for _, name in ipairs(tabNames) do checked[name] = value end
                for _, r in ipairs(rowsUI) do paintRow(r, true) end
                refreshSummary()
            end
            AllBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setAll(true) end)
            NoneBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setAll(false) end)
            refreshSummary()

            local CodeBox = nil
            ExportBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                local sliders, total = {}, 0
                for _, item in ipairs(buildIdMap()) do
                    if checked[item.tab] then
                        local ok, val = pcall(item.entry.GetValue)
                        if ok and type(val) == "number" then
                            sliders[item.id] = val
                            total = total + 1
                        end
                    end
                end

                if total == 0 then
                    setStatus("warn", "No hay ajustes seleccionados", "No settings selected")
                    return
                end

                local ok, encoded = pcall(function()
                    return HttpService:JSONEncode({ version = 1, sliders = sliders })
                end)
                if not ok then
                    setStatus("err", "Error al codificar", "Encoding error")
                    return
                end

                local copied = type(setclipboard) == "function" and pcall(setclipboard, encoded)
                playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.7)
                if copied then
                    setStatus("ok",
                        total .. " ajuste(s) copiados al portapapeles",
                        total .. " setting(s) copied to clipboard")
                    if CodeBox then CodeBox.Visible = false end
                else
                    setStatus("err",
                        "Tu ejecutor no copia: copiá el código de abajo",
                        "Your executor can't copy: copy the code below")
                    -- Respaldo: mostrar el codigo para copiarlo a mano
                    if not CodeBox then
                        CodeBox = mk("TextBox", {
                            Parent = Panel,
                            Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 30),
                            Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -90),
                            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
                            BackgroundTransparency = 0.2,
                            Text = "",
                            TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                            Font = Enum.Font.Code,
                            Te
